f.action: Dash red alert: stop and check the regulator before the lithium battery is damaged.

f.name: Low oil pressure
f.action: EMU Black engine protection cuts the engine (set in the EMU). Dash red alert. Driver stops.

f.name: Coolant over-temperature
f.action: EMU rev limit drops to 8000 rpm, fan forced on. Dash red alert.

f.name: Battery over-voltage
f.action: Dash red alert: stop and check the regulator before the lithium battery is damaged.

f.name: Shutdown circuit opened
f.cond: kill relay coil voltage < 6 V with master switch on
f.action: Engine already stopped in hardware. Fault records which event it was for the log.

f.name: Crank trigger sync lost
f.cond: EMU trigger error counter rising > 2 per second
f.action: Engine misfires or stops. Dash red alert; check the crank and cam VR wiring and shields.

f.name: Not charging
f.action: Dash amber alert. About 13 min of running left on the 4 Ah battery.

f.name: Lean at full throttle
f.action: Dash amber alert, shift light flashes. Check fuel pressure and the fuel table.

f.name: Corner node offline
f.cond: no heartbeat from FL, FR, RL or RR for 500 ms
f.action: Dash amber alert naming the node. Its channels show as missing in the log.

f.name: Sensor open or short
f.cond: any analog input < 0.25 V or > 4.75 V
f.action: Channel marked invalid in the log. Dash amber alert with the channel name.

f.name: Wheel speed implausible
f.cond: one wheel differs from the others by > 15 km/h for 1 s
f.action: Logged. Usually a loose sensor or tone ring gap.

f.name: CAN error passive
f.action: Node still talks but cannot flag errors. Dash amber alert, check that node's wiring.

f.name: Node 5 V rail low
f.action: Ratiometric sensors read wrong. Logged and flagged on the dash.

f.name: Brake light output fault
f.cond: brake light commanded on but current < 50 mA (open LED string or blown fuse)
f.action: Dash amber alert. Fix before the next run: a dead brake light fails tech (T.3.4).

f.name: Brake pressure sensor fault
f.cond: front or rear brake pressure signal < 0.25 V (open) or > 4.75 V (short)
f.action: Brake light falls back to the other circuit. Dash amber alert.

f.name: Low fuel
f.src: Dash MCU (fuel level from EMU + fuel used)
f.cond: filtered fuel estimate < 1.0 L (about 9 laps at 0.106 L/lap)
f.action: Dash amber alert with laps of fuel left. Pit or finish the stint. [proposal, Fuel Level Sensor form]

f.name: Fuel level sender fault
f.cond: sender signal > 2.5 V (open circuit) or < 0.15 V (short to ground)
f.action: Dash falls back to fuel used from injector pulse width. Logged; check the sender plug. [proposal]

f.name: SD card write stall
f.action: Logged with a gap marker. Replace the card if it repeats.

f.name: GPS no fix
f.action: Track map and lap timing fall back to the beacon or wheel speed.
